dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, continuous 2D narrowing of the body mass from the mid-section toward the visible posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity pixels representing a mature white to very light grey skin tone.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple faint, light-colored linear streaks (potential rake marks) situated on the mid-dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint longitudinal linear markings consistent with superficial epidermal scarring or rake marks on the dorsal surface.
